synthetic_reference.header_contract: pipe-delimited transcript_id in field 1 and gene_id in field 2, both versioned
synthetic_reference.generated_genome: selected transcript sequences represented as independent pseudo-contigs
synthetic_reference.generated_annotation: one transcript and one exon spanning each pseudo-contig
synthetic_reference.ambiguity_model: real GENCODE isoforms from the same gene retain shared sequence

selection.algorithm: group genes by exact retained transcript count 1, 2 or 3; sort each group by SHA-256(seed + gene_id); take the first 400

expression.generation_algorithm: draw baseline gene abundance, split across isoforms, apply the condition multiplier, draw each replicate with NB size=1/dispersion, then integer-scale every sample to exactly fragments_per_sample using largest remainders with transcript_id as tie-breaker

differential_expression.assignment_algorithm: sort selected genes by SHA-256(selection_seed + gene_id); assign consecutive blocks in effect_groups order, up then down; all remaining genes are unchanged

truth_calculation.fragment_count: exact integer readmat supplied to Polyester
truth_calculation.gene_tpm: sum transcript_tpm for transcripts mapped to the gene
truth_calculation.true_log2_fold_change: configured condition multiplier before replicate sampling
truth_calculation.true_state: UP if true_log2_fold_change > 0; DOWN if < 0; UNCHANGED if = 0
